measured_facts.grid_v6_and_v7: 3 seeds x 1 prompt, cross-seed CV 78.16% against a 5% gate, NON-REPRODUCIBLE, publish gate BLOCKED; repeated-run CV 0.0000% over 45 runs; 0 of 9 cells share a delivered binary digest across two physical hosts while every measurement matches bit-exactly

measured_facts.gate_defects_found_and_fixed: three, all the same shape. The reproducibility gate passed an axis that never varied because a single-level axis returns 0.0 variance, printing a false PUBLISHABLE. The ground-truth label generator matched the angle brackets in #include directives as comparison operators, so three rename-only pairs were labelled E2 direction error. The decision-escalation rule was built on an approval head later measured anti-correlated with true blast radius.

measured_facts.compile_rate: 6 of 9 generated candidates compiled in the factorial batch
measured_facts.paper: 4 pages, zero compile errors, zero overfull boxes, zero undefined references; carries the prompt spread, the vacuous-axis defect, the label defect and the substrate probe

criteria.cut_a_claim: drop a claim that needs the extra axis and freeze immediately
